paragraphs.text: Kieve is a land in the Domains on the plane Dominaria , north of Orvada . Its shore is called Kieve Beach . The location of Kieve was revealed in the Heroes of Dominaria board game rule book.

Kieve has cities, fiefdoms, castles, and farms, but is considered small and unimportant and often goes beneath notice. Kieve's main city had a market with food stalls that gave way to merchandisers with their gaudy trinkets. A wooden pen owned by a woman wearing antler headgear held a giant bear with a collar of pearly shells latched around its neck. There were jugglers, tricksters, hagglers, thieves, beggars, and more consumers than many a land. Kieve was a prosperous place.
Kieve was ruled by the wizard Thane Du-Moriss IV .
